backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor that combines authorization and blob-storage mixins, manages user profiles with role-based access control, and handles event registrations (workshop/competition/seminar) with admin-only retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented features: saving the total amount to localStorage on the Register page and reading/displaying that amount on the Payment page without recalculation.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source files to short summaries describing each component's purpose, covering App, intro animation, Register, Payment, Success, Contact, Footer, NonTechnicalEvents, and CountdownTimer.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry file that defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar, etc.) used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell titled 'ELECTROSPARKS' with a root div and a module script tag pointing to the React entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that manages the phoenix intro sequence via sessionStorage, sets up TanStack Router with all 8 page routes, and wraps the app in QueryClientProvider and RegistrationProvider.
frontend/src/components/CircuitPattern.t: Decorative SVG background component that renders a tiled circuit-board pattern with orange/red lines, IC chip shapes, and dots at a configurable opacity.
frontend/src/components/CountdownTimer.t: Live countdown timer component that counts down to March 10, 2026 23:59:59, updating every second and displaying Days/Hours/Minutes/Seconds with orange neon glow styling in a glassmorphism container.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with a brand section, quick navigation links, and contact info using a dark/orange theme with TanStack Router navigation.
frontend/src/components/LoadingScreen.ts: Displays an animated loading screen with a canvas-drawn waveform, progress bar, and cycling status messages that completes after ~3 seconds.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with brand logo, desktop nav links, active-route highlighting, scroll-based styling, and a mobile hamburger menu.
frontend/src/components/PhoenixIntro.tsx: Full-screen intro animation that sequences a phoenix icon, department text, title, and subtitle with canvas particle/ember effects before calling onComplete.
frontend/src/contexts/RegistrationContex: React context providing registration form state (RegistrationData) with set and clear actions, exposed via the useRegistration hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using TanStack Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook that manage DFINITY AuthClient login, logout, and identity persistence with status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a `useSubmitRegistration` React Query mutation hook that calls the backend actor's `submitRegistration` method and invalidates the 'registrations' query cache on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts (Orbitron, Share Tech Mono, Rajdhani), sets up Tailwind, and defines a dark neon-cyan themed design system with custom CSS variables and utility classes for glowing text, borders, and buttons.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in TanStack QueryClientProvider and a custom InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page displaying staff and student coordinator details (names, roles, phone numbers) in glassmorphism-styled cards with an orange neon aesthetic and circuit background.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing/hero page for the VibECX-2K26 symposium showing the event title, stats (prize pool, colleges, participants, events), and CTA buttons with an animated fade-in and orange gradient styling.
frontend/src/pages/NonTechnicalEvents.ts: Page listing five non-technical events (AD-MAD, JAM, Dump Charades, Talent Show, E-Sports) in a responsive grid with icon cards and hover effects on a dark background.
frontend/src/pages/Payment.tsx: Payment completion page that reads registration data from context and localStorage, allows uploading a payment screenshot via drag-and-drop or file input, then submits the registration to the backend actor and navigates to a success page.
frontend/src/pages/Register.tsx: Registration form page for VibECX-2K26 that collects participant details, calculates fees based on member count and optional additional event checkbox, validates inputs, and navigates to the payment page.
frontend/src/pages/Schedule.tsx: Event schedule page displaying a filterable list of timed sessions (technical, non-technical, general) with venue and description details for the VibECX-2K26 symposium.
frontend/src/pages/Success.tsx: Post-registration success page that confirms submission, informs the user that a confirmation email will be sent, and displays event details with a home navigation button.
frontend/src/pages/TechnicalEvents.tsx: Static page listing five technical events (Paper Presentation, PCB Design, Technical Crosscode, Tech Talk, Quiz Master) with icons, descriptions, and hover effects in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing helper functions to read, store, retrieve, and clear URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the VibeCX frontend, extending the default theme with custom fonts (Orbitron, Share Tech Mono, Rajdhani), neon cyan color palette, box shadows, animations, and integrating typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the VibeCX project state at schema version 1.0.0, documenting the Registration-to-Payment amount flow via localStorage ('vibecxAmount'), existing implemented features, and a pending auto-sync feature request.
